verdict.rationale: Consensus is a research search/API platform, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis and the evidence directly confirms one exists: "a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app." This is first-party documentation of an official MCP server enabling agent connectivity to Consensus's synthesis/retrieval capabilities. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation the MCP server works, and setup/connection documentation details beyond the single mention.
